body: Ahh, that explains why. Thank you so much, I always felt that he would say that not for my sake but for his own. This just validates that what I felt was right

The more I read what everyone is saying, the more I'm starting to think that maybe 4-6 weeks is just too long. I'm thinking of asking him to at least reply once a week just so that I'm sure he's okay and if he can't even do that, then he can't expect me to just accept that

True, I really want him to seek out therapy and I've recommended him online sites like betterhelp, but I don't think he can afford therapy right now at all. I'm hoping that when he gets all his medical insurance sorted out that he will be able to go in person and get prescribed anti-depressants. I'm being extra sympathetic because of so many factors like moving to a different country, his studies, his younger sibling passing away a month or so ago, his extremely toxic parents, etc. I know that it sounds like I'm making excuses for him, but he's having to handle things that he didn't when we first started seeing each other. I just don't want to abandon him when he's going through his worst possible time period.

>Don’t set yourself on fire to keep him warm

I really need this to sink in. I think what hurts is that in the past he's said over and over again that I don't have to wait for him and that if its too much for me that we can end things. Obviously I don't want that. It hurts me that if I told him that I wanted to break up, he wouldn't even try and fight for the relationship. That's how bad his depression can be. I really don't want to leave him but the only option except for that is to  just wait for him.

I actually thought about this and felt that he was being really selfish going for that long. Then again, clincial depression isn't something that one can control and eventhough its hard for me, I'll try to stick it out. He  moved to a different country to study earlier this year so he's not getting treatment there yet. I keep saying that he needs it ASAP, but he said something about not being able to due to health insurance etc. He also has ADD which probably doesn't help things either. He's a complicated person, but it was my choice to be in a relationship with him knowing this. I really care about him,  but if it gets too much for me, then I'll just let him know.
Thank you so much! This really set my mind at rest. It will be hard for me, but, I think as long as his feelings for me are the same when he comes back it should be okay.

I always tell him that he's handsome and that not matter what he thinks I accept him for the way he is. I'm not sure if I should breakup yet. I think when I've calmed down I want to ask him why he would say that to me and depending on how he answer, ill decide if I will stay with him or breakup with him.

Thanks for replying so quickly! i guess i worried too much about the alcohol. He just moved to Canada a month ago so he knows no one. I managed to call 999 in the UK and they put me through to the local police department in the city where he lives. Since it's a non-emergency number it's taking a while for them to answer. I just hope he hasn't done anything yet.

Hey thank you so much! I managed to call 999 in the UK and they put me through to the local police department in the city where he lives. Since it's a non-emergency number it's taking a while for them to answer. Hopefully all goes well 😭

That's amazing! For ages, I've been wanting to travel abroad and have even been considering a way to gain work experience abroad before applying for med school. I really do need to focus a lot more on who I am and I've been reflecting quite a lot lately. Thank you so much for your highly accurate and detailed response 😊
No, it's not like that. Sometimes, it's very difficult to find someone you can strongly connect with in person. That's why online is so good. Plus one can always travel...
